definition_zh: 在石、金属等硬面上刻写文字；在书上题写赠语；把姓名登记入册；使一个图形内接于另一个图形
definition_en: to write or carve words on a hard surface; to write a dedication in a book; to enter a name in a register; to draw one geometric figure inside another
core_image: 石匠一手扶凿、一手握锤，把名字一笔一画刻进石板，字迹从此留在硬物表面
scene: 考古队员蹲在石壁前，用软刷扫去积尘。A local mason will inscribe the donors' names on the new gatepost.
sceneCN: 这里 inscribe 指「把文字刻写在硬质表面上」（第 1 个义项：在石面刻字）；句意为当地石匠将把捐助者的名字刻在新门柱上。

derivatives.zh: inscribe + -tion（名词后缀）→ 刻下的文字：铭文、题记
inscription + -al（形容词后缀）→ 铭文式的：与铭文有关的
inscribe + -ive（形容词后缀）→ 具有刻写性质的：题写性的
inscribe + -er（施事后缀）→ 刻写的人或工具
inscribe + -ed（分词形容词后缀）→ 被刻写的；内接的

senses.title: Carve words on a hard surface
senses.definition: to write or cut letters into stone, metal, wood or another hard material
senses.definitionCN: 在石头、金属、木材等硬质材料上写出或刻出文字
senses.example: A local mason will inscribe the donors' names on the new gatepost.
senses.exampleCN: 当地石匠将把捐助者的名字刻在新门柱上。
senses.why: in- means 'in or on' and scribere means 'to write'; letters placed onto a hard face are the core act.
senses.whyCN: in- 表示「进入、在上」，scribere 表示「写」；把字放到硬面上就是核心动作。

senses.title: Write a dedication in a book
senses.definition: to write a short personal message, usually a dedication, on the title page of a book
senses.definitionCN: 在书的扉页写下简短的私人赠语，通常是题献
senses.example: The author inscribed the first edition for her old mentor.
senses.exampleCN: 作者在初版书上为她的老师题赠。
senses.why: the same act of writing on a surface narrows to the title page, where a gift message is placed.
senses.whyCN: 仍是把字写在表面上，只是范围收窄到扉页，用来放赠语。

senses.title: Enter a name in a register
senses.definition: to record a name officially on a list, roll or register
senses.definitionCN: 把姓名正式记入名单、名册或登记簿
senses.example: Every new member inscribes a name in the society's roll.
senses.exampleCN: 每位新成员都要在社团名册上登记姓名。
senses.why: a register is a surface written on for official memory, so inscribe took the administrative sense of enrolling.
senses.whyCN: 名册是为官方记忆而写的表面，因此 inscribe 引申出「登记入册」的行政义。

senses.title: Draw one figure inside another
senses.definition: to draw a geometric figure inside another so that its vertices touch the outer boundary
senses.definitionCN: 在一个几何图形内画出另一个图形，使其顶点触及外边界
senses.example: The students inscribed a hexagon in the circle.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们在圆内作了一个内接六边形。
senses.why: geometry borrowed the verb because the inner figure is literally written inside the outer one, touching its edge.
senses.whyCN: 几何学借用这个动词，因为内层图形确实是「写」在外层图形里面，并触及它的边。

senses.title: Fix something in the memory
senses.definition: to fix an idea, lesson or feeling firmly in someone's mind
senses.definitionCN: 把某个观念、教训或情感牢牢固定在某人心中
senses.example: The lesson was inscribed on his memory for decades.
senses.exampleCN: 那一课在他记忆里铭刻了几十年。
senses.why: writing on stone is the image behind the mental sense: what is carved does not fade easily.
senses.whyCN: 以石上刻字为喻：刻下的东西不容易磨灭。

senses.title: Stamp lettering on a coin or medal
senses.titleCN: 在钱币或奖章上压印文字
senses.definition: to stamp or engrave lettering and a design on a coin, medal or seal
senses.definitionCN: 在钱币、奖章或印章上压印或雕刻文字与图案
senses.example: The mint inscribed the date along the rim of the coin.
senses.exampleCN: 造币厂把年份压印在硬币边缘。
senses.why: coins carry their legend on a hard metal face, exactly the surface the Latin verb was made for.
senses.whyCN: 钱币把铭文放在坚硬的金属面上，正是这个拉丁动词最初针对的表面。

senses.title: Dedicate a monument with words
senses.definition: to add a formal engraved statement when a monument or public building is dedicated
senses.definitionCN: 在为纪念碑或公共建筑揭幕时加上正式的刻写说明
senses.example: They inscribed the memorial with a line from the town's first charter.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为纪念碑刻上了小镇最早宪章中的一句话。
senses.why: public dedication joins the writing act to collective memory, so the words are meant for every passer-by.
senses.whyCN: 公共题献把书写行为与集体记忆连在一起，文字是写给每个路人看的。

senses.title: Mark an object with an identifying code
senses.definition: to mark an object with a serial number or code so that it can be identified
senses.definitionCN: 在物件上刻下编号或代码，以便识别
senses.example: The lens was inscribed with a tiny serial number near the mount.
senses.exampleCN: 镜片在卡口附近刻有一个很小的序列号。
senses.why: identifying marks are writing on a surface for later recognition, a practical branch of the same gesture.
senses.whyCN: 识别标记也是把字写在表面上以便日后辨认，是同一动作的实用分支。

intro.en: Inscribe comes from Latin inscribere, 'to write on or write in', built on in- 'in, on' and scribere 'to write'. Scribere goes back to a root meaning 'to cut', which is why carving is the oldest sense.
intro.cn: inscribe 来自拉丁 inscribere「写在上面、写入」，由 in-「进入、在上」与 scribere「写」构成。scribere 更深的词根意为「刻、划」，所以最古老的义项是刻写。

items.en: Scribere meant 'to write'. Its older root carried the idea of cutting or scratching, and that root is offered as a reconstruction rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: scribere 意为「写」。它更早的词根带有「刻、划」的意思，该词根只以重构形式给出，并非有记录的原词。

items.en: In- 'in, on' plus scribere produced inscribere, 'to write on, write in, mark with letters'.
items.cn: in-「进入、在上」加 scribere 构成 inscribere，意为「写在上面、写入、用文字标记」。

items.en: The noun inscriptio, 'a writing upon, an inscription', was formed with the suffix -tio and passed into English as inscription.
items.cn: 名词 inscriptio 意为「写在上面的文字、铭文」，由后缀 -tio 构成，后来进入英语作 inscription。

items.en: English took the verb through Old French. Early examples concern names and words cut into stone, metal or wood.
items.cn: 英语经古法语引入这个动词。早期例子都指刻进石头、金属或木材的名字与文字。

items.en: Translations of Euclid applied the verb to figures drawn inside other figures, and this technical sense has stayed.
items.cn: 欧几里得著作的译本把这个动词用于画在另一图形内部的图形，这一技术义沿用至今。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the earliest English use in the book-dedication sense is not precisely dated, although the sense itself is well recorded.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：书内题赠义最早的英语用例年代不够确切，但该义项本身记载清楚。

note.en: Group one holds verbs that share the Latin root scribere and are often confused; group two holds verbs of marking and enrolling with a different root.
note.cn: 第一组是同出拉丁词根 scribere、容易混淆的动词；第二组是词根不同、表示刻记或登记的近义词。

entries.definition: De- 'down' plus scribere: to write something down in words, hence to tell what it is like.
entries.definitionCN: de-「向下」加 scribere：把某物用文字写下来，因此指描述其样子。

entries.definition: Prae- 'before' plus scribere: to write a rule or remedy in advance, hence to order or recommend.
entries.definitionCN: prae-「在前」加 scribere：事先写下规则或药方，因此指规定或开处方。

entries.definition: Sub- 'under' plus scribere: to write one's name beneath a document, hence to agree or pay for a series.
entries.definitionCN: sub-「在下」加 scribere：在文件下方写下名字，因此指同意或订阅。

entries.definition: Ad- 'to' plus scribere: to write an origin or cause onto someone, hence to attribute.
entries.definitionCN: 「朝向」前缀加拉丁词根 scribere：把来源或原因写到某人名下，因此指归因。

entries.definition: To cut a design or letters into metal or stone; it stresses the cutting tool rather than the act of writing.
entries.definitionCN: 在金属或石头上刻出图案或文字；它强调刀具，而非书写动作。

entries.tag: cut with acid or a needle
entries.definition: To mark a surface with a needle or acid, used especially for printing plates; inscribe is broader.
entries.definitionCN: 用针或酸液在表面留下痕迹，尤用于印版；inscribe 的适用范围更广。

entries.tag: enter a name on a list
entries.definition: To add a name to an official list, especially for a school or organization; it lacks the image of writing on a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 把姓名加入正式名单，尤其是学校或组织；它没有「写在表面上」的形象。

entries.definition: To devote a book, building or work to someone; it names the purpose, while inscribe names the written words.
entries.definitionCN: 把书、建筑或作品献给某人；它说的是用途，inscribe 说的是写下的文字。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real relatives and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构语成分、真实同族词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: in- 'in, on' plus scribere 'write': to write onto a surface.
normal.cn: in-「进入、在上」+ scribere「写」：把字写到表面上。

normal.en: The same root runs through describe, prescribe, subscribe and ascribe.
normal.cn: 同一词根贯穿 describe、prescribe、subscribe 与 ascribe。

normal.en: Inscription keeps the -script- stem visible inside the longer noun.
normal.cn: inscription 在较长的名词里保留了「写」这一词干。

normal.en: The word likes hard surfaces: inscribe a name, a date, a ring, a monument.
normal.cn: 这个词偏爱硬表面：刻名字、刻日期、刻戒指、刻纪念碑。

normal.en: In geometry a polygon is inscribed when all its corners touch the circle.
normal.cn: 几何中，多边形各角都触圆时即为内接。

abstract.en: Writing letters into stone is like sealing a message inside a wall.
abstract.cn: 把字母刻进石头，就像把消息封进墙里。

abstract.en: A name cut into metal can outlive the hand that cut it.
abstract.cn: 刻进金属的名字，能比刻它的那只手活得更久。

abstract.en: A figure fitted inside another is a key turning inside its lock.
abstract.cn: 一个图形嵌进另一个图形，像钥匙在锁里转动。

examples.en: The jeweler inscribed the wedding date inside the ring.
examples.cn: 珠宝匠把婚期刻在戒指内侧。

examples.en: Please inscribe the book to my daughter.
examples.cn: 请在书上题赠给我的女儿。

examples.en: A regular pentagon can be inscribed in a circle.
examples.cn: 正五边形可以内接于圆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「in（进）+ scribe（写）」——把字写进石面里 → 刻写、题写

root: 拉丁 inscribere「写入、刻上」= in-（进入、在上）+ scribere「写」；scribere 更深词根意为「刻、划」，故本义偏「刻写」。英语 inscribe。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: letters are pressed into a surface, and that surface may be stone, a book, a register, a coin, a memory or the inside of a circle.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：把字压进表面，而这个表面可以是石头、书页、名册、钱币、记忆，或一个圆的内部。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand presses letters into a hard face, and the marks stay after the hand is gone.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把字母压进硬面，手离开后痕迹仍在。

branches.en: MARKING A HARD FACE: naming a coin or a wall is the same act of putting letters onto a surface that will keep them.
branches.cn: 在硬面留字：给钱币或墙壁题字，都是把字放到能留住它的表面上。

branches.en: PERSONAL MARK: a gift message and an identifying code both tie private information to a made object.
branches.cn: 私人标记：赠语与识别码都把私人信息绑在一件人造物上。

branches.en: LISTED NAME: enrolling writes a name into the official surface of a register.
branches.cn: 名册上的名字：登记就是把姓名写进名册这个官方表面。

branches.en: GEOMETRIC FIT: the inner figure is written inside the outer one without crossing its edge.
branches.cn: 几何嵌合：内层图形写在外层图形里，不越过它的边。

branches.en: LASTING DEDICATION: memory and public memorials both make the written words stay.
branches.cn: 持久的题献：记忆与公共纪念碑都让写下的字留下来。

intro.en: Inscribe is a Latin verb whose prefix and root still build a large English family, so each part can be read on its own.
intro.cn: inscribe 是一个拉丁动词，其前缀与词根仍构成一大串英语词，因此每一部分都能单独读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin scribere gives scribe, script, describe, prescribe, subscribe and ascribe; in- adds the direction 'in or on'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 scribere 衍生 scribe、script、describe、prescribe、subscribe 与 ascribe；in- 增添「进入、在上」的方向。

items.example: The prefix fixes the direction of the writing.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀确定书写落到的方向。

items.structure: scribere, scripsi, scriptum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: The root names the act of setting letters down.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根命名「把字母写下」的动作。

items.example: The mason will inscribe the names.
The inscription on the ring is barely legible.
items.exampleCN: 戒指上的铭文几乎看不清了。

items.example: The plaque carries an inscriptive line.
She described the stone in detail.
items.exampleCN: 她详细描述了那块石头。

items.example: The law prescribes a fixed penalty.
He subscribed his name to the petition.
items.exampleCN: 他在请愿书下方签了名。

derivatives.zh: inscribe + -tion（名词后缀）→ 刻下的文字：铭文、题记
inscribe + -ive（形容词后缀）→ 起铭文作用的
inscribe + -er（施事后缀）→ 刻写者或刻写工具
inscribe + -ed（分词形容词后缀）→ 被刻写的；内接的
inscription + -al（形容词后缀）→ 铭文式的

definition_en: a small animal with six legs and a body in three parts, such as an ant or a bee
core_image: 一片叶子背面，一只甲虫的身体被切成头、胸、腹三段
scene: 夏夜的灯下，小飞虫不断撞在玻璃上。A tiny insect crawled across the page and stopped on a word.
sceneCN: 这里 insect 是「昆虫」（第 1 个义项：身体三节、六足的小动物）；句意为一只小虫爬过纸页，停在一个词上。图中可辨识物件：叶片、甲虫、台灯。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加表示「杀」的后缀构成，义为「杀虫剂」
由本词加表示「食」的词根构成，义为「食虫动物」
由 insectivore 加后缀构成，义为「食虫的」
由本词加 like 构成，义为「像昆虫的」

senses.title: A six-legged small animal
senses.definition: a small creature with six legs and a body divided into head, thorax and abdomen
senses.definitionCN: 有六条腿、身体分为头胸腹三部分的小生物
senses.example: Ants, bees and beetles are all insects.
senses.exampleCN: 蚂蚁、蜜蜂和甲虫都是昆虫。
senses.why: Insectum means cut into: Roman writers named the class by its visible segments.
senses.whyCN: insectum 意为「被切开的」：罗马作家按可见的分节为这一类命名。

senses.title: Any small crawling creature in loose speech
senses.definition: in everyday language, almost any small crawling or flying bug
senses.definitionCN: 在日常语言中，泛指任何小爬虫或飞虫
senses.example: Something insect-like moved in the grass.
senses.exampleCN: 有像虫子的东西在草丛里动。
senses.why: In loose use the word covers any creeping small creature, though spiders are not insects.
senses.whyCN: 在宽泛用法中它涵盖任何小爬虫，尽管蜘蛛并不属于昆虫。

intro.en: Insect is a Latin word meaning "cut into", given by ancient naturalists who saw the body in sections.
intro.cn: insect 是拉丁语「切开的」一词，古代博物学家见其身体分节而命名。

items.en: Secare meant "to cut", the source of section and segment.
items.cn: secare 意为「切」，是 section 与 segment 的来源。

items.en: Insectum, from in- "into" plus secare, meant "cut into" or "notched".
items.cn: insectum 由 in-「向内」加 secare 构成，意为「切开的、有刻痕的」。

items.en: Pliny and other Roman writers used insecta for animals whose bodies show cuts or segments.
items.cn: 普林尼等罗马作家用 insecta 指身体显出道道切痕或分节的动物。

items.en: English borrowed insect in the seventeenth century as natural history grew.
items.cn: 十七世纪博物学发展，英语借入 insect 一词。

items.en: Later science narrowed it to the six-legged class, while speech kept the looser sense.
items.cn: 后来科学把它收窄到六足纲，口语仍保留较宽的用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin verb of cutting; the near-meaning group gathers other small creatures.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「切」动词；近义组收其他小型生物。

entries.definition: A part cut from a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「部分、切面」，同根。

entries.definition: A chemical that kills insects.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「杀虫剂」，由本词构成。

entries.definition: To cut something apart in order to study it.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「解剖」，同根。

entries.definition: The everyday word for a small insect, and a computer fault.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「小虫」，日常用语，也指程序错误。

entries.definition: A kind of insect with hard wing cases.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「甲虫」，昆虫的一类。

entries.definition: An eight-legged creature, not an insect at all.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「蜘蛛」，八足，并非昆虫。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use secare, the Latin verb of cutting, and the collocations the word takes.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用拉丁语「切」动词 secare，以及这个词的搭配。

normal.en: Secare is to cut: an insect is a body cut into three parts.
normal.cn: secare 是「切」：insect 就是被切成三部分的身体。

normal.en: Insect, section and dissect all come from the same cutting verb.
normal.cn: insect、section、dissect 都出自同一个「切」的动词。

normal.en: An insect has six legs, a spider has eight.
normal.cn: 昆虫有六条腿，蜘蛛有八条。

normal.en: Insect repellent keeps the mosquitoes away.
normal.cn: insect repellent 用来驱蚊。

normal.en: Insecticide kills insects, and insectivores eat them.
normal.cn: insecticide 杀虫，insectivore 吃虫。

abstract.en: Picture a leaf with a beetle on it, the body lined in three clear bands.
abstract.cn: 想象一片叶子上的甲虫，身体分三道清晰的纹。

abstract.en: The name is a description: nature was classified by its visible notches.
abstract.cn: 这个名字本身就是描述：自然按可见的刻痕被分类。

abstract.en: Small as insects are, they outnumber us and pollinate most of what we eat.
abstract.cn: 昆虫虽小，数量却远超我们，还为我们大部分食物授粉。

examples.en: Insects play a vital role in pollination.
examples.cn: 昆虫在授粉中起关键作用。

examples.en: He brushed the insect off his sleeve.
examples.cn: 他把袖子上的虫子拂掉了。

examples.en: This insect lives only in dry grassland.
examples.cn: 这种昆虫只生活在干燥的草原上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因塞克特」——因身上「塞」满了节段，才叫昆虫

root: 拉丁语 secare「切」加 in-「向内」构成 insectum「切开的、有刻痕的」，普林尼用它指体节分明的动物；十七世纪入英语，后科学上专指六足纲。同根词有 section、dissect、segment。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses: the strict zoological class, and the loose everyday word for a small bug.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项：严格的动物学分类，以及口语里对小虫的泛称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a beetle on a leaf, its body divided into three clear sections.
core.cn: 核心意象：叶上的甲虫，身体分为三节。

branches.en: THE GARDEN: insects are both pests and helpers in gardens.
branches.cn: 花园这条线：insect 在园中既是害虫也是帮手。

branches.en: THE CLASS: six legs and three body parts define the zoological insect.
branches.cn: 分类这条线：六足与三节身体定义了动物学上的昆虫。

branches.en: THE NIGHT LAMP: loose speech calls every small flying thing an insect.
branches.cn: 夜灯这条线：口语把一切小飞虫都叫 insect。

branches.en: THE PAGE: a crawling speck on a book is an insect in ordinary talk.
branches.cn: 书页这条线：书上的小爬虫在日常说法里也算昆虫。

branches.en: THE THREAD: in both senses the creature is small, many-legged and everywhere.
branches.cn: 线索这条线：两种用法里，它都小而多足，无处不在。

intro.en: Insect is a Latin past participle used as a noun, with English compounds built on it later.
intro.cn: insect 是拉丁语过去分词作名词使用，后来在英语里构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin secare and insectum are recorded; the adjective insectus and noun insecta both appear in Roman writers.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 secare 与 insectum 均有记录，形容词 insectus 与名词 insecta 都见于罗马作家笔下。

items.example: It marks cutting into the body.
items.exampleCN: 它标出切入身体的动作。

items.example: The root also gives section and segment.
items.exampleCN: 这一词根还给出 section 与 segment。

items.example: It appears in dissect and section.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 dissect 与 section 中。

items.example: The Latin source of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这是本词的拉丁语来源。

items.example: It forms insecticide.
It forms insectivore.
It forms insectivorous.
It forms insect-like.

definition_zh: 杀虫剂；杀昆虫剂；（比喻）摧毁某类人群的手段
definition_en: a substance used to kill insects
core_image: 一只喷雾器在叶背喷出极细的白雾，雾里的细滴落在虫体上，虫子几分钟内松开了抓握的脚
scene: 农场在播种前把药液兑进水箱，沿着田垄均匀喷洒。 The insecticide is applied at dusk, when the bees have stopped flying.
sceneCN: 这里 insecticide 指「杀虫剂」（第 1 个义项：用于杀死昆虫的化学制剂）；句意为杀虫剂在黄昏施用，那时蜜蜂已经停止飞行。

derivatives.zh: 杀虫的
昆虫
农药；除害剂
除草剂
杀真菌剂

senses.title: A substance that kills insects
senses.definition: a chemical or biological agent used to kill insects
senses.definitionCN: 用于杀死昆虫的化学或生物制剂
senses.example: The insecticide is applied at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 杀虫剂在黄昏施用。
senses.why: insect plus Latin -cide 'killing' states the function directly, so the word needs no explanation beyond its parts.
senses.whyCN: insect 加拉丁 -cide「杀」直接表明功能，因此这个词除字面成分外无需解释。

senses.title: A product class in farming
senses.titleCN: 农业中的一个产品类别
senses.definition: one product category among the crop-protection chemicals sold to growers
senses.definitionCN: 出售给种植者的作物保护化学品中的一个产品类别
senses.example: Insecticide accounts for a shrinking share of the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 杀虫剂在预算中所占比重正在缩小。
senses.why: a category name is used uncountably to mean the whole product line, not one bottle.
senses.whyCN: 类别名以不可数形式指整条产品线，而非某一瓶。

senses.title: A broad-spectrum agent
senses.definition: a preparation that kills many insect species rather than one target
senses.definitionCN: 杀死许多昆虫物种而非单一目标对象的制剂
senses.example: Broad-spectrum insecticides also remove the predators.
senses.exampleCN: 广谱杀虫剂连捕食者一并清除。
senses.why: the qualifier describes the range of the same agent, since the killing function does not change.
senses.whyCN: 限定语描述同一制剂的作用范围，杀灭功能并未改变。

senses.title: A selective or systemic agent
senses.definition: an agent that acts on one group, or one taken up by the plant and carried through its tissue
senses.definitionCN: 只对某类昆虫起作用、或被植物吸收并在组织中输送的药剂
senses.example: A systemic insecticide protects new growth from inside.
senses.exampleCN: 内吸性杀虫剂从内部保护新生的枝叶。
senses.why: the technical qualifiers describe how the agent moves, not a different kind of substance.
senses.whyCN: 技术限定语描述药剂如何移动，而非另一类物质。

senses.title: Residue left on food or in water
senses.definition: the trace of the chemical that remains on produce, soil or water after use
senses.definitionCN: 使用后留在农产品、土壤或水中的化学痕迹
senses.example: Tests found insecticide residue on the imported fruit.
senses.exampleCN: 检测在进口水果上发现杀虫剂残留。
senses.why: the mass noun is used for the measurable remainder, because the material is the same as the product.
senses.whyCN: 物质名词用于可测量的余留量，因为其材料与产品相同。

senses.title: The problem of resistance
senses.definition: the condition in which target insects survive treatment and pass on tolerance
senses.definitionCN: 目标昆虫在施药后存活并把耐受性传下去的情形
senses.example: Insecticide resistance appeared within a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 抗药性在十年之内就出现了。
senses.why: the word stands for the pressure the chemical applies, so the insects' answer is named against it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词代表药剂施加的压力，因此昆虫的应对是依它命名的。

senses.title: Household and public-health products
senses.definition: consumer or public-health preparations such as sprays, powders and treated nets
senses.definitionCN: 喷雾、粉剂与浸药蚊帐等消费或公共卫生制剂
senses.example: The clinic distributes insecticide-treated nets each spring.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所每年春天发放浸药蚊帐。
senses.why: the delivery form changes, but the active function is still killing insects.
senses.whyCN: 施用形式变了，但有效功能仍是杀死昆虫。

senses.title: Figurative: something that wipes out a group
senses.titleCN: 比喻：一举清除某类人的东西
senses.definition: figurative, any measure that eliminates a category of people or things wholesale
senses.definitionCN: 比喻用法，指成批清除某类人或事物的任何手段
senses.example: Critics called the policy an insecticide for small shops.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者把这项政策称为针对小店铺的杀虫剂。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps the wholesale killing and drops the insects, which makes the word deliberately harsh.
senses.whyCN: 比喻保留成批杀灭、舍去昆虫，正因如此这个词显得刻意刺人。

intro.en: Insecticide is a nineteenth-century compound of insect and Latin -cide 'a cutting, a killing', from caedere 'to cut, strike'.
intro.cn: insecticide 是 19 世纪复合词，由 insect 与拉丁 -cide「切、杀」构成，后者出自 caedere「切、击」。

items.en: Caedere meant 'to cut, strike, kill', and its combining form -cide builds homicide, suicide and pesticide.
items.cn: caedere 意为「切、击、杀」，其组合形式 -cide 构成 homicide、suicide、pesticide。

items.en: Insect came from Latin insectum 'cut into', the calque of Greek entomon, and named the target of the agent.
items.cn: insect 来自拉丁 insectum「被切开」，是希腊 entomon 的仿译，命名药剂的作用对象。

items.en: The compound appeared in English as chemical control of crop pests expanded in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 随着 19 世纪化学防治农作物害虫的扩展，这个复合词在英语中出现。

items.en: Synthetic organic compounds made insecticide a mass-market product, and residue and resistance entered the vocabulary with it.
items.cn: 合成有机化合物使杀虫剂成为大众市场产品，residue 与 resistance 随之进入词汇。

items.en: The model spread to herbicide, fungicide and rodenticide, which share the -cide ending but name different targets.
items.cn: 这一模式扩展到 herbicide、fungicide、rodenticide，共用 -cide 词尾但对象不同。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact earliest English use of insecticide is not firmly dated, so the dating here is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：insecticide 最早英语书证的确切年代不详，此处年代为约数。

note.en: Group one separates the -cide family, where the target, not the suffix, decides the meaning; group two separates insecticide from related control methods.
note.cn: 第一组区分 -cide 词族，决定词义的是对象而非后缀；第二组区分杀虫剂与相关防治手段。

entries.definition: Pest + -cide covers insects, weeds, fungi and rodents; insecticide is the insect-only member of that class.
entries.definitionCN: pest 加 -cide 涵盖虫、草、菌、鼠；insecticide 是该类中只针对昆虫的成员。

entries.definition: Herb + -cide kills plants; the ending is the same but the target is entirely different.
entries.definitionCN: herb 加 -cide 杀植物；词尾相同但对象完全不同。

entries.definition: Kills fungi; the shared ending marks killing, not insects.
entries.definitionCN: 杀真菌；共用词尾只标记「杀」，与昆虫无关。

entries.definition: The adjective describes a substance or effect that kills insects; the noun is the substance itself.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词描述杀虫的物质或效果；名词指物质本身。

entries.definition: A repellent keeps insects away rather than killing them, so it works before contact.
entries.definitionCN: 驱避剂把昆虫赶开而非杀死，因此在接触之前起作用。

entries.definition: A fumigant is a gas released in an enclosed space; it may be insecticidal but is defined by its form.
entries.definitionCN: 熏蒸剂是在封闭空间释放的气体；可能具杀虫性，但以形态定义。

entries.definition: Uses predators or parasites instead of chemicals; insecticide implies a substance, not an organism.
entries.definitionCN: 用捕食者或寄生者代替化学品；insecticide 暗示物质而非生物。

entries.definition: Poison is any harmful substance; insecticide is a poison formulated and labelled for insects.
entries.definitionCN: poison 泛指任何有害物质；insecticide 是为昆虫配制并标示的毒物。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin components, real product terms and real sibling compounds.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实拉丁成分、真实产品术语与真实同构复合词。

normal.en: insect + -cide 'killing': literally the insect killer.
normal.cn: insect + -cide「杀」：字面就是杀虫之物。

normal.en: The -cide family runs pesticide, herbicide, fungicide, rodenticide.
normal.cn: -cide 词族包括 pesticide、herbicide、fungicide、rodenticide。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: insecticide resistance, insecticide residue, broad-spectrum insecticide.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：杀虫剂抗性、杀虫剂残留、广谱杀虫剂。

normal.en: Latin caedere 'to cut, kill' also gives homicide and suicide.
normal.cn: 拉丁 caedere「切、杀」还构成 homicide 与 suicide。

normal.en: The adjective is insecticidal, formed with -al.
normal.cn: 形容词是 insecticidal，由 -al 构成。

abstract.en: Picture a fine mist that makes a grip loosen in minutes.
abstract.cn: 想象一层细雾，几分钟内就让紧抓的脚松开。

abstract.en: Picture a field where the loudest insects are gone and the quiet ones starve.
abstract.cn: 想象一片田，最吵的虫子没了，安静的也随之饿死。

abstract.en: Picture a word so harsh it turns a policy into a poison.
abstract.cn: 想象一个词严厉到把政策说成毒药。

examples.en: Farmers rotated two insecticides to slow resistance.
examples.cn: 农民轮换使用两种杀虫剂以延缓抗性。

examples.en: The label warns that the insecticide is toxic to fish.
examples.cn: 标签警告该杀虫剂对鱼有毒。

examples.en: Bees are exposed to insecticide dust drifting from treated fields.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂会接触到从施药田飘来的杀虫剂粉尘。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「insect（昆虫）+ cide（杀）」——杀昆虫的药 → 杀虫剂

root: insect（拉丁 insectum「被切开者」，即昆虫）+ 拉丁 -cide「杀」，出自 caedere「切、击、杀」。词源清楚，仅首见年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one spray: an agent kills insects, and the word then names a product class, a broad range, a selective action, a residue, a resistance problem, a household form, and finally any measure that clears a group of people.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次喷雾展开：药剂杀死昆虫；词语随后指产品类别、宽作用范围、选择性作用、残留、抗性问题、家用形态，最后指任何成批清除某类人的手段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fine mist settling on an insect, whose grip loosens within minutes.
core.cn: 核心意象：细雾落在虫体上，它的抓握几分钟内松开。

branches.en: AGENT AND CATEGORY: one substance, then the whole product line.
branches.cn: 药剂与类别：一种物质，然后是整条产品线。

branches.en: RANGE AND ROUTE: broad or selective, contact or systemic.
branches.cn: 范围与路径：广谱或选择，触杀或内吸。

branches.en: WHAT REMAINS: the same material measured after use.
branches.cn: 余留之物：使用后被测量的同一材料。

branches.en: THE ANSWER: insects evolve around the chemical.
branches.cn: 回应：昆虫在化学压力下演化。

branches.en: FORM AND FIGURE: a household sachet, or a harsh metaphor for elimination.
branches.cn: 形态与修辞：家用小包，或关于清除的严厉比喻。

intro.en: Insecticide is two roots joined without a prefix: a target noun and a Latin killing suffix.
intro.cn: insecticide 是两个词根直接相连，无前缀：一个对象名词加拉丁「杀」后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin caedere supplies -cide, and the same suffix builds pesticide, herbicide and homicide; insectum supplies the target.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 caedere 提供 -cide，同一后缀构成 pesticide、herbicide、homicide；insectum 提供对象。

items.structure: in- + secare (Latin participle used as noun)
items.example: The insect is the target.
The suffix states the function.
The same root builds homicide.

items.meaning: having the quality of killing insects
items.example: The dust had an insecticidal effect.

items.meaningCN: 泛指杀灭有害生物之物
items.example: Pesticide is the wider legal category.
items.exampleCN: pesticide 是更宽的法律类别。

items.example: Herbicide is used between the rows.
Fungicide protects the vines.
Rodenticide is placed in bait stations.
The label lists the cidal spectrum.

definition_zh: 插入；嵌入；（在文字中）添加
definition_en: to put something inside or between other things, or to add words to a text
core_image: 一枚硬币被手指推进投币口的窄缝里
scene: 打印机卡纸了，说明书上有一行加粗的提示。Insert the card face up and wait for the light to turn green.
sceneCN: 这里 insert 是「插入」（第 1 个义项：把东西放进或放进两物之间）；句意为正面朝上插入卡片，等指示灯变绿。图中可辨识物件：卡片、插槽、指示灯。

pos.zh: 动词：插入；嵌入；添加（文字）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「插入；插入物」
由本词加后缀构成，义为「可插入的」
由本词加前缀构成，义为「重新插入」

senses.title: To put inside
senses.definition: to put something carefully inside something else or between two things
senses.definitionCN: 小心地把某物放进另一物之内或两物之间
senses.example: Insert the plug into the socket.
senses.exampleCN: 把插头插入插座。
senses.why: In- "into" plus serere "to join, weave" gives "to join in": something is threaded into a place already filled.
senses.whyCN: in-「向内」加 serere「连接、编织」，意为「编进去」：把东西穿进已经占满的位置。

senses.title: To add words to a text
senses.definition: to add a word, sentence, or paragraph to a piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 在文章中增添词语、句子或段落
senses.example: Insert a comma after the first clause.
senses.exampleCN: 在第一个从句后加一个逗号。
senses.why: Text has its own gaps, so an insertion is a piece of writing threaded into the existing line.
senses.whyCN: 文字有它自己的空隙，所以插入就是一段文字被编进已有的行里。

senses.title: Something put in
senses.definition: a loose sheet, picture, or object placed inside something else
senses.definitionCN: 放在其他东西里面的散页、图片或物件
senses.example: The magazine came with a colour insert.
senses.exampleCN: 这本杂志附有一张彩色插页。
senses.why: The noun uses the same form and names the very thing that was threaded in.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式相同，指的就是被编进去的那件东西。

intro.en: Insert comes from a Latin verb of joining or weaving in, which is why it suggests careful threading rather than pushing.
intro.cn: insert 来自拉丁语表示「编入、接入」的动词，因此它暗示的是细心穿入而非硬塞。

items.en: Serere meant "to join, bind, weave", the root of series and sermon.
items.cn: serere 意为「连接、编织」，是 series 与 sermon 的词根。

items.en: Inserere, from in- plus serere, meant "to graft or insert, to weave into".
items.cn: inserere 由 in- 加 serere 构成，意为「嫁接、插入、编入」。

items.en: The noun insertio was used for grafting plants and for joining words.
items.cn: 名词 insertio 用于植物嫁接，也用于词语接入。

items.en: English borrowed insert in the sixteenth century for both planting and writing.
items.cn: 英语十六世纪借入 insert，兼用于种植与文字。

items.en: Modern use centres on cards, plugs, and paragraphs added to texts.
items.cn: 现代用法集中在卡片、插头以及插入正文的段落。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin verb of joining; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of putting something inside.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「连接」动词；近义组收把东西放进里面的动词。

entries.definition: The act of putting something in, or the thing put in.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「插入、插入物」。

entries.definition: A number of things joined in order.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「系列」，即依次连接之物。

entries.definition: To state something firmly, with a different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「断言」，形近但前缀不同。

entries.definition: The plain phrase for placing something inside.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「放入」，最朴素的说法。

entries.definition: To join something to a group or a text without the idea of a tight fit.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「添加」，不含紧贴嵌入之意。

entries.definition: To fix something firmly into living tissue or a mind.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「植入」，多指植入活体组织或观念。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use serere, the verb of weaving, and the phrases insert appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用「编织」动词 serere，以及 insert 的搭配。

normal.en: Serere is to weave: to insert is to thread something into a place.
normal.cn: serere 是「编织」：insert 就是把东西穿进某个位置。

normal.en: Insert takes a direct object: insert a card, insert a comma.
normal.cn: insert 直接带宾语：insert a card、insert a comma。

normal.en: Insert into is the form used with a container.
normal.cn: 与容器连用时用 insert into。

normal.en: Insertion is the noun; reinsert means to do it again.
normal.cn: 名词是 insertion；reinsert 表示重新插入。

normal.en: A colour insert falls out of the magazine.
normal.cn: 彩色插页从杂志里掉出来。

abstract.en: Picture threading a needle: the fit must be exact, not forced.
abstract.cn: 想象穿针引线：要严丝合缝，不能硬塞。

abstract.en: To insert is to interrupt a line without breaking it.
abstract.cn: 插入是在不打乱整体的前提下在中间加入。

abstract.en: Writers insert clauses the way joiners fit new pieces of wood.
abstract.cn: 作者插入从句，正如木匠嵌入新的木料。

examples.en: Insert your ticket into the machine.
examples.cn: 把车票插入机器。

examples.en: She inserted a new line into the report.
examples.cn: 她在报告里加了一行。

examples.en: The book has an eight-page photographic insert.
examples.cn: 这本书有八页的摄影插页。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因瑟特」——因要把卡片「瑟」进缝里，便是插入

root: 拉丁语 serere「连接、编织」加 in-「向内」构成 inserere「编入、插入」，名词 insertio 用于嫁接与文字；英语十六世纪借入 insert。同根词有 insertion、series。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: putting an object in, adding words to a text, and the thing that is put in.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：放入物体、在文字中添加，以及被放进去的东西本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coin is pushed into the narrow slot of a machine.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚硬币被推进机器的窄缝。

branches.en: THE SLOT: cards and plugs are inserted into narrow openings.
branches.cn: 插槽这条线：卡片与插头被插进狭窄的开口。

branches.en: THE GRAFT: gardening uses the same verb for joining a shoot to a stem.
branches.cn: 嫁接这条线：园艺用同一个动词表示把枝条接到树干上。

branches.en: THE PAGE: writers insert clauses and commas into a finished line.
branches.cn: 纸页这条线：作者把从句与逗号插入已有的行里。

branches.en: THE MAGAZINE: an insert is a loose sheet placed inside.
branches.cn: 杂志这条线：insert 指夹在里面的散页。

branches.en: THE THREAD: every sense describes something entering an existing order without replacing it.
branches.cn: 线索这条线：每个义项都在描述某物进入既有秩序而不替代它。

intro.en: Insert is a Latin prefix on a weaving root, with an English verb ending preserved from Latin.
intro.cn: insert 是拉丁语前缀加「编织」词根，动词词尾沿用拉丁语形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin serere, inserere and insertio are recorded, along with series and sertum.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 serere、inserere、insertio 均有记录，还有 series 与 sertum。

items.example: It marks the direction of joining.
The root of series too.
It shows in insert and insert usages.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 insert 相关形式中。

items.example: The direct source of the verb.
It forms insertion.
It forms reinsert.
A cousin from the same root.
Another form made from the same stem.
items.exampleCN: 这是由同一词干构成的另一形式。

definition_zh: 洞察力；洞见；深刻的理解
definition_en: a clear and deep understanding of a person, problem, or situation
core_image: 一束光照进原本昏暗的屋子，屋里摆着的东西忽然看清楚了
scene: 会议开到深夜，白板上写满了没人看得懂的关系图。Her insight into the market saved the company from a costly mistake.
sceneCN: 这里 insight 是「洞察、深刻的理解」（第 1 个义项：对人或问题清楚深刻的理解），句意是她对市场的洞察让公司免于一次代价高昂的错误。画面里能看到的物件：白板、关系图、台灯。

pos.zh: 名词：洞察力；洞见；深刻理解

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ful 构成，义为「富有洞见的」
由 insightful 加 -ly 构成，义为「有洞见地」
由 insightful 加 -ness 构成，义为「洞察力」

senses.title: Deep understanding
senses.definition: the ability to see the true nature of a situation or a person, often hidden from others
senses.definitionCN: 看清情境或人物真实本质的能力，这种本质常为他人所不见
senses.example: The book gives a rare insight into village life.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书对乡村生活给出了罕见的洞见。
senses.why: In- plus sight: sight turned inwards, past the surface, to what is really there.
senses.whyCN: in- 加 sight：向里看的目光，越过表面，看到真正存在的东西。

senses.title: A sudden clear idea
senses.definition: a sudden clear understanding that solves a problem or changes how you see it
senses.definitionCN: 突然获得的清晰理解，解决了问题或改变了看法
senses.example: She had an insight while walking home and rewrote the whole plan.
senses.exampleCN: 她走回家的路上顿悟，把整个计划重写了。
senses.why: Turning sight inwards can happen in a flash; the word also names that flash rather than the lasting ability.
senses.whyCN: 「向里看」可以发生在一瞬之间，这个词也指那一瞬，而不只是持久的能力。

senses.title: Information that reveals something
senses.definition: useful knowledge about how something really works, gained from inside
senses.definitionCN: 从内部获得的、关于某事物真实运作方式的有用知识
senses.example: Analysts used buying data to gain insight into customer habits.
senses.exampleCN: 分析师用购买数据来了解顾客习惯。
senses.why: Business and research adopted the word for knowledge that comes from looking inside the data.
senses.whyCN: 商业与研究领域用这个词指从数据内部看出来的知识。

intro.en: Insight is a native compound of in and sight, formed on the model of the verb to see into.
intro.cn: insight 是本族语复合词，由 in 与 sight 组成，按「看进去」的说法造成。

items.en: Sith "sight, view" is Old English, related to the verb to see.
items.cn: sith「视觉、景象」见于古英语，与动词 see 有关。

items.en: The preposition in was freely combined with nouns to mark the inner side.
items.cn: 古英语介词 in 常与名词组合，表示内侧。

items.en: The noun insight appears in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries in the sense of inner vision.
items.cn: 名词 insight 在十三、十四世纪出现，义为「内心的看见」。

items.en: The sense shifts from vision to understanding during the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪，词义从「视觉」转向「理解」。

items.en: Modern psychology and management made insight a technical term for self-knowledge and analysis.
items.cn: 现代心理学与管理学把 insight 变成自我认识与分析的术语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the sight image; the near-meaning group holds other words for understanding.
note.cn: 形近组共享「看见」这一意象；近义组收其他表示「理解」的词。

entries.definition: The ability to see, or something seen.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「视力、景象」，是复合的另一半。

entries.definition: The ability to see what is coming; built with fore- instead of in-.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「远见」，用 fore- 而非 in- 构成。

entries.definition: Understanding of events only after they happen.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「事后聪明」，用 hind-「后面」构成。

entries.definition: The general word for knowing how something works.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「理解」，是最宽泛的说法。

entries.definition: The way something is noticed or interpreted, not necessarily deep.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「知觉、看法」，不一定深刻。

entries.definition: Knowledge felt without proof, often unspoken.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「直觉」，指没有证据的感觉。

normalIntro.en: These hooks play on the literal "sight turned inwards" and the phrases the word takes.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子利用字面的「向里看的目光」，以及这个词的常用搭配。

normal.en: in plus sight: seeing inside, not just seeing.
normal.cn: in 加 sight：看见里面，而不只是看见。

normal.en: Compare foresight and hindsight, built the same way.
normal.cn: 可对比用同样方式构成的 foresight 与 hindsight。

normal.en: Gain insight into a problem before proposing a fix.
normal.cn: 在提出解决办法前先深入了解问题。

normal.en: A good interview yields insight, not just quotes.
normal.cn: 好的访谈带来洞察，而不只是引语。

normal.en: Insightful writing shows rather than tells.
normal.cn: 有洞见的文字靠展示，而不是靠陈述。

abstract.en: Imagine a lamp switched on inside a dark shed.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗的棚屋里忽然亮起一盏灯。

abstract.en: Insight is seeing the wiring behind the wall.
abstract.cn: 洞察是看见墙背后的线路。

abstract.en: Insight arrives without knocking, usually in the middle of something else.
abstract.cn: 洞察从不敲门，常在别的事情中间到来。

examples.en: The interviews gave us insight into how parents choose schools.
examples.cn: 这些访谈让我们深入了解家长如何择校。

examples.en: He has real insight into his own mistakes.
examples.cn: 他对自己的错误有真正的洞察。

examples.en: The poem ends with a quiet insight about grief.
examples.cn: 这首诗以对悲伤的平静领悟收尾。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因 sight」——因为看得见里面，才有洞见

root: 英语本族语复合词：古英语 in「在内」+ siht/sith「视觉、景象」（与 see 同源）。按「看进内部」的说法造成，十七世纪词义由「内在视象」转为「深刻理解」，与 foresight、hindsight 同构。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: lasting deep understanding, the sudden flash, and useful inside knowledge.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：持久的深刻理解、突然的顿悟，以及有用的内部知识。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp switches on inside a dark shed and everything becomes clear.
core.cn: 核心意象：暗棚屋里亮起一盏灯，一切忽然清楚。

branches.en: THE LAMP: the lasting ability to see deeply.
branches.cn: 台灯这条线：持久地看得深的能力。

branches.en: THE FLASH: understanding that arrives in a moment.
branches.cn: 闪光这条线：一瞬间到来的理解。

branches.en: THE DATA: knowledge gained from inside a system.
branches.cn: 数据这条线：从系统内部获得的知识。

branches.en: THE LINK: both come from looking inward rather than at surfaces.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都来自朝里看而非看表面。

branches.en: THE TONE: the sudden sense is more personal and emotional.
branches.cn: 语气线：顿悟义更个人化、更有情绪。

intro.en: Insight is in- plus the native noun sight, exactly parallel to foresight and hindsight.
intro.cn: insight 是 in- 加本族名词 sight，与 foresight、hindsight 完全同构。

latinIntro.en: The word is not Latin; the Latin-derived noun sight of the mind is listed only as a comparison.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词并非拉丁来源，列出的拉丁同源对照词仅供参考。

items.example: It marks the direction of looking.

items.meaning: the power or act of seeing
items.example: The second half supplies the image.
The same pattern with fore-.
items.exampleCN: 用 fore- 的同一模式。

items.example: The same pattern with hind-.
items.exampleCN: 用 hind- 的同一模式。

items.example: The suffix -ful means full of.
Over- shifts the sense to missing something.
Also names what is looked at.

items.meaning: the ability to see or imagine
items.example: The Latin-based partner of sight.
items.exampleCN: 与 sight 对应的拉丁来源词。

definition_en: to say firmly that something must happen or is true, and refuse to give way
core_image: 一个人双手按在桌上，把同一句话再说一遍
scene: 饭馆里两个人抢着付账，谁也不肯退让。She insisted on paying for the meal herself.
sceneCN: 这里 insist 是「坚持要求」（第 1 个义项：坚决要求某事必须如此）；句意为她坚持自己付这顿饭钱。图中可辨识物件：账单、餐桌、钱包。

pos.zh: 动词：坚持；坚决要求；坚称

collocations.zh: 如果你一定要这样的话

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「坚持；坚决主张」
由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「坚持的；迫切的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「坚持地」

senses.title: To demand firmly
senses.definition: to demand something firmly, refusing to accept a refusal
senses.definitionCN: 坚决要求某事，不接受拒绝
senses.example: He insisted on seeing the manager.
senses.exampleCN: 他坚持要见经理。
senses.why: Insistere is to stand upon: a demand repeats until the ground no longer moves.
senses.whyCN: insistere 是「站上去」：要求反复提出，直到脚下的地面不再移动。

senses.title: To state firmly as true
senses.definition: to say something firmly and repeatedly as true, even when others doubt it
senses.definitionCN: 在他人怀疑时仍反复断言某事为真
senses.example: She insists that she never saw the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 她坚称自己从未见过那封信。
senses.why: A claim insisted upon is a claim the speaker will not withdraw under doubt.
senses.whyCN: 被 insist 的主张，是说话者在质疑下也不撤回的主张。

intro.en: Insist is Latin in- plus sistere "to stand": to keep standing on a point.
intro.cn: insist 是拉丁语 in- 加 sistere「站立」：坚持站在某一点上。

items.en: Sistere meant "to stand, to stop, to set in place".
items.cn: sistere 意为「站立、停住、安置」。

items.en: Insistere, from in- plus sistere, meant "to stand upon, to press upon".
items.cn: insistere 由 in- 加 sistere 构成，意为「站在上面、压在上面」。

items.en: In argument the image became to stand firm on a demand or a claim.
items.cn: 在辩论中，这一意象演变为在要求或主张上站稳脚跟。

items.en: French insister passed the verb to English in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 法语 insister 在十六世纪把这个动词传入英语。

items.en: English insists on something, insists that something is true, or insists that someone act.
items.cn: 英语里可以说 insist on 某事、insist that 某事为真，或 insist that 某人去做。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin verb of standing still; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of firm demand.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「站住」动词；近义组收表示坚决要求的动词。

entries.definition: To stand against something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「抵抗」，即站在对面。

entries.definition: To keep standing, to continue stubbornly.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「坚持、持续」，强调一直不停。

entries.definition: To stand together, to be made up of.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「由……组成」。

entries.definition: To ask for something as a right, forcefully.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「要求」，语气强硬，带有权利意味。

entries.definition: To keep saying that something is true.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「坚持声称」，多见于书面。

entries.definition: To keep doing something despite difficulty.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「执意坚持」，强调不顾阻力的持续。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use sistere, the verb of standing, and the patterns insist appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用「站立」动词 sistere，以及 insist 的句型。

normal.en: Sistere is to stand: to insist is to stand on a point and not move off it.
normal.cn: sistere 是「站立」：insist 就是站在一点上不让步。

normal.en: Insist on takes an -ing form: insist on paying.
normal.cn: insist on 后接动名词：insist on paying。

normal.en: Insist that can also trigger a bare verb: they insist that he leave.
normal.cn: insist that 后也可接动词原形：they insist that he leave。

normal.en: Resist, persist and insist all involve taking a stand.
normal.cn: resist、persist、insist 都与「站定立场」有关。

normal.en: If you insist is the polite way to give way.
normal.cn: if you insist 是礼貌让步的说法。

abstract.en: Picture feet planted on one stone while the argument washes around them.
abstract.cn: 想象双脚牢牢踩在一块石上，争论在四周翻涌。

abstract.en: To insist is to make your position stronger than the pressure against it.
abstract.cn: 坚持就是让自己的位置强过压来的力量。

abstract.en: Firmness can protect another person's dignity, or simply one's own pride.
abstract.cn: 执着既能保护他人的体面，也可能只是护住自己的骄傲。

examples.en: They insisted on checking every detail.
examples.cn: 他们坚持要核对每一个细节。

examples.en: He insisted that the money was his.
examples.cn: 他坚称那笔钱是他的。

examples.en: If you insist, I will come with you.
examples.cn: 如果你一定要这样，我就陪你去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因塞斯特」——因他「塞」住不放，才叫坚持

root: 拉丁语 sistere「站立」加 in-「在上」构成 insistere「站上去、压上去」，在争论中引申为坚持主张；经法语 insister 于十六世纪入英语。同根词有 resist、persist、consist、exist。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses: standing firm on a demand, and standing firm on a claim of fact.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项：在要求上站稳立场，以及在事实主张上站稳立场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: feet planted on a single stone while the argument swirls round.
core.cn: 核心意象：双脚踩定一块石头，争论在四周盘旋。

branches.en: THE TABLE: one diner insists on paying the whole bill.
branches.cn: 餐桌这条线：一位客人 insists on 付整笔账单。

branches.en: THE OFFICE: a customer insists on seeing a manager.
branches.cn: 办公室这条线：顾客 insist on 见经理。

branches.en: THE COURT: a witness insists that the facts were as stated.
branches.cn: 法庭这条线：证人坚称事实就是所述那样。

branches.en: THE FAMILY: people insist on being right within their own homes.
branches.cn: 家庭这条线：人在自己家里也要 insist 自己是对的。

branches.en: THE THREAD: both senses refuse to let the point be moved.
branches.cn: 线索这条线：两个义项都拒绝让那个点被挪动。

intro.en: Insist is a Latin prefix on the verb for standing, and English keeps its Latin stem.
intro.cn: insist 是拉丁语前缀加「站立」动词，英语沿用其拉丁词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin sistere, insistere and the related stare are recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sistere、insistere 以及相关的 stare 均有记录。

The root of resist and persist.
items.exampleCN: resist 与 persist 的词根。

items.example: The direct source of insist.
items.exampleCN: 这是 insist 的直接来源。

items.example: It survives in all the English forms.
items.exampleCN: 它在英语各形式中留存。

definition_en: the state of being unable to sleep, or a lasting difficulty in falling or staying asleep
core_image: 床头的钟走了一整夜，眼睛始终睁着
scene: 连续两周，他每夜只能睡两三个小时，白天靠浓咖啡撑着。By the third week, insomnia had worn him down until he could barely think.
sceneCN: 这里 insomnia 是「失眠症」（第 2 个义项：持续多夜、已成病症的那种失眠）；句意为到了第三周，失眠已经把他拖得几乎无法思考。

forms.label: 不可数名词（通常无复数）

derivatives.zh: 失眠患者；由 insomnia 换 -ac（指人）构成，也可作形容词
失眠的；睡不着的；由拉丁语 insomnis 加 -ous 构成

senses.title: Sleeplessness
senses.definition: the condition of being awake when one wants to sleep, especially on one particular night
senses.definitionCN: 想睡却醒着的状态，尤指某一个夜里
senses.example: A bad cough gave him one night of insomnia.
senses.exampleCN: 一场剧烈的咳嗽让他失眠了一夜。
senses.why: Latin in- denies and somnus is sleep, so the word simply states the absence of sleep.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 in- 表示否定，somnus 是睡眠，所以这个词只是直白地说「没有睡眠」。

senses.title: The persistent disorder
senses.definition: a lasting pattern of poor sleep that leaves a person tired and impaired during the day
senses.definitionCN: 长期睡不好、白天疲惫且状态受损的一种病症
senses.example: Insomnia is diagnosed when the problem lasts for weeks rather than for one night.
senses.exampleCN: 失眠持续数周而不是一夜时，才会被诊断为失眠症。
senses.why: Medicine turned the simple absence of sleep into a disorder once doctors saw that it persists and harms the day.
senses.whyCN: 当医生发现「睡不着」会持续下去并损害白天的状态，医学就把单纯的缺觉变成了一种病症。

senses.title: Trouble falling asleep
senses.definition: the form of insomnia in which a person lies awake for a long time before sleeping
senses.definitionCN: 躺了很久仍睡不着的那一类失眠
senses.example: Her insomnia begins at bedtime, when the lights go out.
senses.exampleCN: 她的失眠从熄灯上床那一刻开始。
senses.why: Because sleep has two gates, the word splits into a failure to enter sleep and a failure to stay in it.
senses.whyCN: 睡眠有两道门，这个词于是分成「进不去」和「待不住」两种情形。

senses.title: Waking in the night
senses.definition: the form of insomnia in which a person wakes repeatedly or too early and cannot sleep again
senses.definitionCN: 夜里反复醒来或醒得太早、再难入睡的那一类失眠
senses.example: His insomnia shows up at three in the morning, when he cannot fall back asleep.
senses.exampleCN: 他的失眠出现在凌晨三点，醒了就再难睡回去。
senses.why: Staying asleep is the second gate, and its failure earned the same name as the first.
senses.whyCN: 「睡得住」是第二道门，它失守时也用了同一个名字。

senses.title: Secondary insomnia
senses.definition: insomnia caused by another condition, such as pain, a drug or anxiety
senses.definitionCN: 由疼痛、药物或焦虑等其他状况引起的失眠
senses.example: The pain in his back brought on a secondary insomnia.
senses.exampleCN: 背痛引起了他的继发性失眠。
senses.why: When another illness keeps a patient awake, the sleeplessness becomes a symptom that borrows the name.
senses.whyCN: 当别的病让患者睡不着时，失眠就成了借用这个名字的一个症状。

intro.en: Insomnia is Latin in-, not, plus somnus, sleep: the word spells out its own meaning.
intro.cn: insomnia 是拉丁语 in-（不）加 somnus（睡眠）：这个词把自己的意思直接拼了出来。

items.en: Somnus named sleep, and the god of sleep carried the same name.
items.cn: somnus 指睡眠，睡神也用这个名字。

items.en: The prefix in- denied the word it joined, turning sleep into no sleep.
items.cn: 前缀 in- 否定它所接的词，把「睡眠」变成「没有睡眠」。

items.en: Insomnis described a person or a night without sleep.
items.cn: insomnis 形容不眠的人，也形容不眠的夜。

items.en: Insomnia turned the adjective into a noun naming sleeplessness itself.
items.cn: insomnia 把这个形容词变成名词，直接命名「睡不着」这件事。

items.en: English borrowed the Latin noun in the seventeenth century, at first for medical writing.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入这个拉丁名词，起初用于医学写作。

items.en: Sleep medicine later defined insomnia as a disorder with a duration and a daytime cost, not merely one bad night.
items.cn: 睡眠医学后来把失眠症定义为有持续时间、并带来白天代价的病症，而不只是一夜没睡好。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the Latin sleep root, and the near-meaning group separates insomnia from the tiredness and the sleep disorders around it.
note.cn: 形近组守住拉丁语「睡眠」这个词根；近义组把失眠与它周围的疲惫和睡眠疾病分开。

entries.definition: a person who rarely sleeps well, also used as an adjective
entries.definitionCN: 长期睡不好的人，也可作形容词；由 insomnia 换 -ac 构成。

entries.definition: sleepless or unable to sleep
entries.definitionCN: 失眠的；睡不着的；由拉丁语 insomnis 加 -ous 构成。

entries.definition: sleepy or inclined to sleep
entries.definitionCN: 困倦的、想睡的；与 insomnia 同出拉丁语 somnus（睡眠）。

entries.definition: the state of not sleeping, without implying a disorder
entries.definitionCN: 没睡着的状态，不暗示已成病症，范围比 insomnia 宽。

entries.definition: the condition that results from not getting enough sleep
entries.definitionCN: 睡眠不足造成的状态，是结果，而 insomnia 是原因。

entries.definition: a disorder in which a person falls asleep uncontrollably
entries.definitionCN: 无法控制地入睡的疾病，方向与失眠正好相反。

normalIntro.en: Insomnia is Latin in-, not, plus somnus, sleep, so the word form already carries its meaning.
normalIntro.cn: insomnia 是拉丁语 in-（不）加 somnus（睡眠），词形本身就已经带着它的意思。

normal.en: In- says not and somnus says sleep, so insomnia is literally no sleep.
normal.cn: in- 是「不」，somnus 是「睡眠」，insomnia 字面就是「没有睡眠」。

normal.en: Somnolent and somnambulist carry the same sleep root, one sleepy and one walking in sleep.
normal.cn: somnolent 与 somnambulist 共享同一个「睡眠」词根，一个指困倦，一个指梦游。

normal.en: An insomniac is the person, and insomnious is the rarer adjective for the sleepless state.
normal.cn: insomniac 指人，insomnious 是较少用的形容词，形容失眠的状态。

normal.en: Insomnia is uncountable, so a bout of insomnia names one episode.
normal.cn: insomnia 不可数，说 a bout of insomnia 才指一阵失眠。

normal.en: Sleep deprivation is the effect, while insomnia is the difficulty that causes it.
normal.cn: sleep deprivation 是结果，insomnia 则是造成它的那个困难。

abstract.en: Picture a clock above the bed, its hands moving while the eyes stay open.
abstract.cn: 想象床头上方有一只钟，指针在走，眼睛却一直睁着。

abstract.en: Imagine weeks of short nights and a face that grows grey in daylight.
abstract.cn: 想象连续数周夜夜短睡，一张脸在白天越来越灰。

abstract.en: Think of a body lying still while the mind keeps running through the day.
abstract.cn: 想象身体躺着不动，脑子却把白天的事一遍遍过。

examples.en: Insomnia made her dread the sound of the clock at night.
examples.cn: 失眠让她一到夜里就害怕听见钟声。

examples.en: He has struggled with insomnia since he changed jobs.
examples.cn: 换工作之后，他一直受失眠困扰。

examples.en: Doctors first treat insomnia by changing sleep habits.
examples.cn: 医生先通过改变睡眠习惯来治疗失眠。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「硬睡么」——躺在床上硬要睡，偏偏睡不着，正好是这个意思；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ somnus（睡眠）→ insomnis（不眠的）→ insomnia（失眠）→ 英语直接借入，核心义「没有睡眠」。

sensesIntro.en: The word runs from one sleepless night to the lasting disorder, then splits into the two gates of sleep, and finally covers sleeplessness caused by something else.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从一夜没睡，走到长期的病症，再分成睡眠的两道门，最后指由别的病引起的失眠。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clock above the bed moving all night while the eyes stay open.
core.cn: 核心意象：床头的钟走了一整夜，眼睛始终睁着。

branches.en: One sleepless night is the plain everyday sense.
branches.cn: 一夜没睡，是最日常的义项。

branches.en: The lasting disorder is the medical sense.
branches.cn: 长期存在的病症，是医学义项。

branches.en: Failing to enter sleep is the first of the two gates.
branches.cn: 进不了睡眠，是两道门中的第一道。

branches.en: Waking in the night is the other gate.
branches.cn: 夜里醒来，是另一道门。

branches.en: A single bad night and sleeplessness caused by pain share one word.
branches.cn: 一夜没睡好，与疼痛引起的失眠，共用一个词。

intro.en: Insomnia is Latin in- plus somnus, and the same stem returns in insomniac, insomnious and somnolent.
intro.cn: insomnia 是拉丁语 in- 加 somnus，同一个词干还出现在 insomniac、insomnious 与 somnolent 里。

latinIntro.en: Latin somnus means sleep, insomnis means sleepless, and insomnia names the condition itself.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 somnus 是睡眠，insomnis 是不眠的，insomnia 则命名这种状态本身。

definition_en: to look at something closely in order to judge its quality or find problems
core_image: 一双眼凑近齿轮，把每一道纹路都看一遍
scene: 车间里，质检员拿着记录板在机器之间慢慢走动。An engineer came to inspect the bridge after the flood.
sceneCN: 这里 inspect 是「检查、视察」（第 1 个义项：仔细查看以判断质量或发现问题）；句意为洪水过后有工程师来检查这座桥。图中可辨识物件：记录板、齿轮、手电筒。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「检查；视察」
由本词加表示人的后缀构成，义为「检查员；督察」
由 inspector 加后缀构成，义为「检查机构」

senses.title: To look at closely
senses.definition: to look at something carefully in order to judge it or find faults
senses.definitionCN: 为判断好坏或发现问题而仔细查看
senses.example: He inspected the tyres before the long drive.
senses.exampleCN: 长途出发前他检查了轮胎。
senses.why: Inspectare is to look over and over: the eye goes into the detail on purpose.
senses.whyCN: inspectare 是「反复查看」：眼睛有目的地深入细节。

senses.title: To visit officially to check
senses.definition: to visit a place officially and check that rules or standards are being kept
senses.definitionCN: 以官方身份到某地查看规章或标准是否被遵守
senses.example: Officials will inspect the school next month.
senses.exampleCN: 官员们下个月将来视察这所学校。
senses.why: When the state does the looking, inspection becomes a formal visit with authority behind it.
senses.whyCN: 当由国家来看时，inspection 就成了有权威支撑的正式到访。

intro.en: Inspect is Latin in- plus specere "to look": to look into something on purpose.
intro.cn: inspect 是拉丁语 in- 加 specere「看」：有目的地往里面看。

items.en: Specere meant "to look, observe", the root of spectacle, species and respect.
items.cn: specere 意为「看、观察」，是 spectacle、species、respect 的词根。

items.en: Inspectare, a frequentative of inspicere, meant "to look into, examine repeatedly".
items.cn: inspectare 是 inspicere 的反复形式，意为「往里看、反复查看」。

items.en: The noun inspectio was used of examining property and accounts.
items.cn: 名词 inspectio 用于察看财产与账目。

items.en: English adopted inspect in the seventeenth century for official and technical checks.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪采用 inspect，用于官方与技术的检查。

items.en: Modern use spans tyres, factories, bridges, and imported goods.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖轮胎、工厂、桥梁与进口货物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin verb of looking; the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of checking.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「看」动词；近义组收其他表示查看的动词。

entries.definition: To look back at someone with esteem.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「尊敬」，同根。

entries.definition: A person who watches an event.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「观众」，同根。

entries.definition: To look up at someone with doubt.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「怀疑」，同根。

entries.definition: To look at something in detail, often to test it.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「检查、考查」，强调细究或测试。

entries.definition: To make sure something is correct or safe, quickly.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「核对」，通常较快。

entries.definition: To look over a whole area or situation.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「勘察、调查」，强调整体俯瞰。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use specere, the verb of looking, and the collocations the word takes.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用「看」的动词 specere，以及这个词的搭配。

normal.en: Specere is to look: to inspect is to look into something on purpose.
normal.cn: specere 是「看」：inspect 就是有目的地往里看。

normal.en: Respect, suspect and inspect are all ways of looking at someone.
normal.cn: respect、suspect、inspect 都是「看」的不同方式。

normal.en: An inspector inspects; an inspection is what he carries out.
normal.cn: inspector 负责 inspect，而 inspection 是他所做的检查。

normal.en: Inspect for damage means looking specifically for faults.
normal.cn: inspect for damage 意为专门查找破损。

normal.en: Goods are inspected before they leave the port.
normal.cn: 货物在离港前要接受查验。

abstract.en: Picture a magnifying glass over a seam: the eye decides what the hand will fix.
abstract.cn: 想象放大镜对准一道接缝：眼睛决定手该修哪里。

abstract.en: Inspection is trust replaced by evidence.
abstract.cn: 检查是用证据取代信任。

abstract.en: To inspect is to look with a question already in mind.
abstract.cn: 审视是带着问题去看。

examples.en: The car was inspected before it was sold.
examples.cn: 这辆车售出前接受过检查。

examples.en: Health officers inspect restaurants twice a year.
examples.cn: 卫生官员每年检查餐馆两次。

examples.en: She inspected the letter closely, looking for a date.
examples.cn: 她仔细查看那封信，想找日期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因斯派克特」——因要细细「看」，才去检查

root: 拉丁语 specere「看」加 in-「向内」构成 inspicere「往里看」，反复形式 inspectare 与名词 inspectio 经英语借入作 inspect；同根词有 respect、suspect、spectator、spectacle。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses: looking closely at a thing, and looking over a place in an official role.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项：仔细查看某物，以及以官方身份巡查某地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an eye brought close to a gear, following every groove.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼睛凑近齿轮，顺着每道沟纹看过去。

branches.en: THE WORKSHOP: goods are inspected before they are passed.
branches.cn: 车间这条线：货物在通过之前要受检。

branches.en: THE ROAD: tyres and brakes are inspected for safety.
branches.cn: 道路这条线：轮胎与刹车要检查是否安全。

branches.en: THE SCHOOL: an official visit checks that standards are kept.
branches.cn: 学校这条线：官方到访核查标准是否被维持。

branches.en: THE PORT: customs officers inspect imported goods.
branches.cn: 港口这条线：海关人员查验进口货物。

branches.en: THE THREAD: both senses look with a judgement in mind, not for pleasure.
branches.cn: 线索这条线：两种看都带着判断目的，而非为了欣赏。

intro.en: Inspect is a Latin prefix on the verb for looking, with a frequentative Latin stem.
intro.cn: inspect 是拉丁语前缀加「看」的动词，词干取反复形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin specere, inspicere, inspectare and inspectio are recorded, along with the related spectrum.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 specere、inspicere、inspectare、inspectio 均有记录，还有相关的 spectrum。

The root of spectacle and species.

definition_en: a careful look at something to judge its condition, quality, or safety
core_image: 戴手套的人俯身贴近机器，用手电照着焊缝一寸寸看过去
scene: 车间里机器刚停下，一名佩戴证件的工作人员拿着手电靠近焊缝。A careful inspection showed that the pipe had a small crack.
sceneCN: 这里 inspection 是「检查」（第 1 个义项：为判断状况、质量或安全而仔细查看），句意是仔细检查后发现管道上有一条细裂缝。画面里能看到的物件：手电、焊缝、证件。
